cues: Its thick yellow peel bends around a long, gently curved shape.
Inside, pale flesh stays soft and creamy, even when the exterior remains firm.
The fruit grows in tight clusters, each piece hanging from a shared stalk.
As it ripens, tiny brown freckles spread across its yellow outer skin.
A slight crescent shape and blunt ends make it easy to recognize.
Its skin can be pulled away in long strips without using a knife.
